pin.meaning: PIN to verify against the local credential seat; on stdin, not argv. The declared flags carrier is also read; the gate consumes flags.exousia.pin before dispatch.

publicKey.meaning: Expected public key. The stop requires exactly 64 characters and a value parseable by Python int(value, 16), then lowercases it for comparison; the actual verifier key is lowercase hex.

verified.meaning: Whether the comparison succeeded. A completed comparison emits ok true even when verified is false; the child signal is not forwarded.

exceptionType.meaning: Exception class when the front door catches an unhandled stop exception.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: Only the front door emits this field on an unhandled exception. Ordinary input refusals are stderr-only.

stderr.meaning: Raw diagnostic lines on the non-JSON error path. An internal failure also prints a leading exception-class and diagnostic line; no receipt is emitted on these paths.
